subject: Walkthrough: Integration feasibility check — Redwood + FinServe.ai
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Walkthrough: Integration feasibility check — Redwood + FinServe.ai

Hi Aliyah,

Thanks again for agreeing to a technical walkthrough. Confirming our working session on Wednesday, May 19 at 11:00 AM PT — we plan a 45-minute demo focused on integration feasibility and connection patterns.

Attachments: integration-agenda.pdf (3 pages) — high-level flow + checklist, env-checklist.txt — pre-demo environment items.

Proposed agenda (attached as a one-pager):
- 11:00–11:10: quick intros + scope (SE + PM)
- 11:10–11:30: live demo — auth, routing, KV/prefix cache behavior
- 11:30–11:40: discussion of TCO/latency considerations and data controls
- 11:40–11:45: next steps and rollout checklist

If you prefer a shorter 30-minute session that focuses only on auth + live traffic, let me know and we'll tighten the agenda.

Joining: Dylan (principal SE) and Marissa (product PM) will be on the call. I'll send the calendar invite separately.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

We logged into the meeting at 11:00 and waited until 11:15 but didn't see you or any placeholder from FinServe. Dylan and Marissa were on the line and ready to walk through the items in the agenda.

If something came up on your side, no worries — we can rebook. Below are a few immediate options we can commit to this week:
- Thu May 20, 9:00–9:30 AM PT (short auth + connect demo)
- Thu May 20, 2:00–2:45 PM PT (full 45m)
- Fri May 21, 11:00–11:30 AM PT (short)

If none of those work, please propose two windows and we'll lock one in.

For transparency: we did not record since there was no attendee from FinServe; attaching a quick screenshot of the empty attendee list.

Thanks — happy to be flexible.

Subject: Quick internal: reschedule scope suggestion

Stephanie / Marissa — quick thought while we're waiting: if we reschedule, I'd prefer to offer a focused 30-minute slot that covers (1) SSO & network egress, (2) a short 7–8 minute live demo of the KV/prefix cache behavior with a <1s latency example, and (3) one slide on rollout patterns (canary + fallback). That keeps it tight for engineering leads.

I can prepare a small snippet that hits the FinServe auth flow (assume OAuth with mutual TLS) and mock the token exchange — should be low friction. I'm good for Thu 2pm if they want the full 45, or Thu 9am for the compact session.

—Dylan

- Auth & connectivity checklist (5–7m)
- Live demo: model routing, prefix/KV cache example (10–12m)
- Ops & data controls: rollout, logging, retention (8–10m)
- Q/A + next steps (5m)

Slots we're holding on our side (pick one):
- Thu May 20, 9:00–9:30 AM PT — short, focused (recommended for engineering lead + network owner)
- Thu May 20, 2:00–2:45 PM PT — full walkthrough (SE-led demo + PM discussion)
- Fri May 21, 11:00–11:30 AM PT — short replay

If you prefer, we can also do a recorded 12-minute demo and then do a 20-minute sync to go over questions.

Links and attachments: integration-agenda.pdf (attached) and environment checklist (env-checklist.txt) — if you can confirm that the Dev/Stage endpoints are reachable from our test IPs, that will speed the demo. HubSpot note with proposed slots: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-112
